content_zh:
第449章肿瘤科主任
周萍萍和周雪丽简直都要羞死了。
“你个老登瞎说什么呢，别教坏小孩子！”
“小雨你看电视去，别在这儿问东问西的，大人的事儿你现在问了也不懂的，等你将来长大就明白了。”
周雪丽和周萍萍一先一后的说道，两个女人的脸颊红的都快滴血了。
好不容易搞定了周欣雨这个小丫头，哄她去客厅看电视，然后周雪丽和周萍萍就跟赵大柱一起进了屋。
说实话，她们两个也等不及了。
中午两点半，赵大柱才终于心满意足的从周雪丽家里出来。
回想着刚才周雪丽和周萍萍两个女人在床上你争我抢的模样儿，赵大柱心里快活的要死。
怪不得说每个男人都梦想齐人之福呢，这齐人之福确实非常美妙！
时间很快就来到三点，刺耳的手机铃声准时响起。
赵大柱掏出手机一看就发现是个来电号码，不用想都能知道打来电话的是董乐乐这个丫头，于是立刻接通电话并把手机凑到耳边。
果不其然，手机里立马就传出了董乐乐略带紧张以及羞臊的声音。
“赵大爷，你现在有空了吗？可以跟我一起去医院，给李阿姨检查治疗了吗？”
赵大柱笑道：“当然可以，我已经等你的电话好一会儿了，你现在在哪里？”
“我在铂悦府小区。”董乐乐回答道。
“那我现在就过去跟你汇合。”
赵大柱说罢就挂断电话，转过身朝着铂悦府的方向大步走去。
还没到铂悦府小区的大门口呢，赵大柱就已经看到董乐乐这个年轻漂亮身姿婀娜的女孩在等自己了。
而且今天的董乐乐打扮的十分清纯，身上穿着的是白色的连衣裙，脚上的高跟凉鞋也是白色的，头上还戴着一定纯白的太阳帽。

她这个打扮，简直就像是一朵在风中摇曳的白兰花，看的赵大柱都有些怦然心动了。
可惜董乐乐没有穿丝袜，要是再穿上白色的丝袜那肯定就更好看了！
“赵大爷！”
董乐乐也看到赵大柱了，立即就挥手大喊。
赵大柱于是加快脚步走了过去，到了面前就笑着说道：“乐乐你今天打扮的也太好看了，不知道的还以为你要跟男人约会呢！”
“我……我就是为了赵大爷你打扮的嘛，我要是邋里邋遢的，惹你生气了怎么办？”董乐乐害羞脸红，搓着小手手说道。
“专门为我打扮的啊？好好好，不错，你有心了！”
赵大柱心满意足的点点头，凑过去说道：“那你下次把丝袜也穿上，我喜欢丝袜，更喜欢穿丝袜的女人。”
“赵大爷你真色。”董乐乐羞涩的头都快抬不起来了。
“你应该庆幸我好色，我要是不好色的话咱两能在一起吗？我还会给你帮忙吗，还会给你那个李阿姨检查治疗吗？”赵大柱没好气的说道。
“赵大爷你怎么说都有理，我说不过你。”董乐乐羞答答的说道。
“行了甭废话了，跟我走吧。”
赵大柱说罢就把手伸了过去，直接搂住了董乐乐纤柔的小蛮腰，甚至还把手放在董乐乐那浑圆挺翘的臀儿上面。
而董乐乐虽然害臊的不得了，脸颊红扑扑的就像熟透了的红苹果，却没有丝毫的挣扎反抗，反而还往赵大柱的身上靠了靠，就好像恨不得在这里跟赵大柱融为一体似的。

Chapter 449 Director of Oncology Department
Zhou Pingping and Zhou Xueli were so embarrassed that they died of embarrassment.
"What are you talking nonsense about? Don't teach bad things to children!"
"Xiao Yu, go watch TV. Don't ask questions here. You don't understand adults' things even if you ask them now. You will understand when you grow up."
Zhou Xueli and Zhou Pingping said one after another. The two women's cheeks were so red that they were almost bleeding.
After finally getting rid of the little girl Zhou Xinyu, she coaxed her to go to the living room to watch TV. Then Zhou Xueli and Zhou Pingping entered the house with Zhao Dazhu.
To be honest, the two of them couldn't wait any longer.
At half past two in the afternoon, Zhao Dazhu finally came out of Zhou Xueli's house with satisfaction.
Thinking back to the way Zhou Xueli and Zhou Pingping fought for each other on the bed just now, Zhao Dazhu felt extremely happy.
No wonder every man dreams of the blessing of being together. This blessing of being together is indeed very wonderful!
The time soon came to three o'clock, and the piercing ringtone of the mobile phone rang on time.
Zhao Dazhu took out his mobile phone and saw that it was a caller number. He knew that the caller was Dong Lele without even thinking, so he immediately answered the call and put the mobile phone to his ear.
Sure enough, Dong Lele's slightly nervous and shy voice immediately came from the phone.
"Uncle Zhao, are you free now? Can you go to the hospital with me to check and treat Aunt Li?"
Zhao Dazhu smiled and said: "Of course, I have been waiting for your call for a while. Where are you now?"
"I'm in Boyuefu Community." Dong Lele replied.
"Then I'll go over and join you now."
After Zhao Dazhu said that, he hung up the phone, turned around and strode towards the direction of Boyue Mansion.
Before he arrived at the gate of Boyuefu Community, Zhao Dazhu had already seen Dong Lele, a young, beautiful and graceful girl waiting for him.
And today, Dong Lele was dressed very innocently. She was wearing a white dress, high-heeled sandals on her feet, and a pure white sun hat on her head.
The way she was dressed looked like a white orchid swaying in the wind, which made Zhao Dazhu's heart skip a beat.
It's a pity that Dong Lele didn't wear stockings. It would definitely look better if she wore white stockings!
"Uncle Zhao!"
Dong Lele also saw Zhao Dazhu and immediately waved and shouted.
Zhao Dazhu then quickened his pace and walked over. When he got in front of him, he smiled and said, "Lele, you look so good today. If you don't know, you'd think you're going on a date with a man!"
"I...I dressed up just for you, Uncle Zhao. What if I am sloppy and make you angry?" Dong Lele blushed shyly and rubbed his little hands.
"Did you dress up specifically for me? Okay, okay, yes, you are interested!"
Zhao Dazhu nodded with satisfaction, leaned over and said, "Then you should also wear stockings next time. I like stockings, and I like women who wear stockings even more."
"Uncle Zhao, you are so sexy." Dong Lele was so shy that he could hardly lift his head.
"You should be glad that I'm horny. If I wasn't horny, could we be together? Would I still help you, and would I still check and treat your Aunt Li?" Zhao Dazhu said angrily.
"Uncle Zhao, whatever you say makes sense, I can't explain it to you." Dong Lele said shyly.
"Okay, stop talking nonsense and come with me."
After Zhao Dazhu said that, he stretched out his hand and directly hugged Dong Lele's slender waist, and even put his hand on Dong Lele's round and perky buttocks.
Although Dong Lele was extremely shy and her cheeks were as red as a ripe red apple, she did not struggle and resist at all. Instead, she leaned against Zhao Dazhu, as if she wished she could merge with Zhao Dazhu here.
